solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique, linked answer split by the grid); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Again join sappers company beginning to bore in excavation

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, the British army's sappers

indicators.note: in places the letter from bore inside the excavation word

parts.note: a mine is a dug-out excavation

indicators.note: the beginning of a word is its first letter, so take the opening of bore

explanation.surface: Military engineers and their company dig back into a mine, starting to bore through again.
explanation.definitionFit: To recombine is to put parts back together once more, a straight synonym.

clue.text: Book covered by radical automaton

indicators.note: covered by means the book letter sits inside the radical word, which wraps it

parts.note: a radical is a root, as in a mathematical or word root

explanation.surface: A book wrapped in an extremist cover turns out to be about a machine man.
explanation.definitionFit: An automaton is a self-operating machine, a synonym of a mechanical man.

clue.text: Contender's criminal entertaining bits of fluff

indicators.note: entertaining means holding as a guest, so the criminal word contains the fluff word

parts.note: a con is a convict, a criminal
lint is fine fluffy fibre

explanation.surface: A slur on a presidential candidate: a crook who entertains bimbos.
explanation.walkthrough: 's stands for 'is' and links definition to wordplay. 'Bits of fluff' tempts as slang for attractive women; here it is literal fluff.
explanation.definitionFit: Hillary Clinton was a contender in the 2016 US presidential election, the puzzle's theme.

clue.text: Angry Rene drowns one with litres in soup

parts.note: mad means angry

indicators.note: drowns means submerges, so Rene goes over and around the other letters

parts.note: the name Rene is used as written
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: An angry Frenchman, Rene, chokes one person with litres of soup.
explanation.definitionFit: Madrilene is a clear consommé flavoured with tomato, a kind of soup.

clue.text: Little devil has timetable to imprison current despot

parts.note: an imp is a little devil

indicators.note: to imprison means to lock up inside, so the time word holds the current letter

parts.note: the first half, time, gives era
I is the symbol for electric current
the second half, table, gives list

explanation.surface: A mischievous imp schedules a tyrant's capture.
explanation.walkthrough: The single word 'timetable' supplies two pieces, 'time' then 'table'. 'Has' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: An empire-builder ruling over others by force can be called a despot, a loose synonym.

clue.text: Cheers up, supporting introduction to Edvard Munch

indicators.note: supporting in a down clue means sitting beneath the other piece
an introduction is the start, so take the first letter of Edvard
in a down clue, up means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: ta is British slang for thanks, or cheers

explanation.surface: A toast celebrating the painter Edvard Munch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Munch' looks like the artist's surname, but it is the definition, a verb meaning to chew.
explanation.definitionFit: To munch is to chew food steadily, so it is a synonym of consume.

clue.text: Contender's not entirely genuine politician

indicators.note: not entirely means a word is cut short, so the final letter of the genuine word is dropped

parts.note: true means genuine
MP is a Member of Parliament, a politician

explanation.surface: A jibe that a candidate is a not-quite-honest politician.
explanation.definitionFit: Donald Trump was a contender in the 2016 US presidential election, the puzzle's theme.

clue.text: In Sanskrit, he takes letter from Greek

indicators.note: In tells us the letters lie within the words Sanskrit, he takes

explanation.surface: Someone writing in Sanskrit borrows a letter from the Greek alphabet.
explanation.definitionFit: Theta is the eighth character of the Greek alphabet, an example of a Greek letter.

clue.text: UN and China disposed to grant release

parts.note: used as written

indicators.note: disposed means arranged or set out, so the letters of UN and China are rearranged

parts.note: used as written

explanation.surface: The United Nations and Beijing are inclined to agree to a prisoner's release.
explanation.walkthrough: UN stays as it is; only China is rearranged by 'disposed'.
explanation.definitionFit: To unchain someone is to free them from fetters, a synonym of setting loose.

clue.text: Leader here embraces Independence Day for starters

indicators.note: embraces means hugs around, so the here word surrounds the two initials

parts.note: present means here, in attendance

indicators.note: starters are the first letters, so take the openings of Independence and Day

explanation.surface: A national leader attends Independence Day celebrations.
explanation.definitionFit: A president is the head of state, so a leader of the nation.

clue.text: To construct at higher level requires publicity

definitions.meaning: to raise a building by adding more storeys
a promotional campaign hyping something in advance

explanation.surface: Adding storeys to a building needs promotion.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses come from the phrasal verb: raising structures, and hyping something ahead of an event.

clue.text: For syrup say maple contains a centilitre

indicators.note: contains means the tree word holds the other letters inside it

parts.note: a maple is an example of a tree, signalled by say
CL is the abbreviation for centilitre

explanation.surface: Maple syrup measured out by the centilitre.
explanation.definitionFit: Treacle is the British name for a thick dark syrup made from sugar refining.

clue.text: Played by whole orchestra? Express annoyance about it!

parts.note: tut is a click of disapproval

indicators.note: about means turned round, so the word it is read backwards

explanation.surface: A conductor huffs at a passage the full orchestra must play.
explanation.definitionFit: Tutti is a musical direction meaning all performers play together.

clue.text: Selassie's artist getting time to stop hunting expedition

definitions.note: read as 'Selassie is', naming the Ethiopian emperor by his earlier title

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, an artist

indicators.note: to stop means to plug, so the time letter goes inside the expedition word

parts.note: a safari is a hunting expedition

explanation.surface: Haile Selassie's painter takes time off a safari.
explanation.definitionFit: Before his coronation Haile Selassie was known by this title and name, so it identifies the emperor.

clue.text: Extravagant NHS dept aggravated break in relations

indicators.note: aggravated means stirred up, so the letters of NHS dept are rearranged

parts.note: used as written
a rift is a breach in a relationship

explanation.surface: A wasteful health-service department causes a falling-out.
explanation.walkthrough: NHS is Britain's National Health Service.
explanation.definitionFit: A spendthrift is a wasteful person, used adjectivally to mean wasteful with money.

clue.text: Tail removed from fish in barrel

indicators.note: the tail is the last letter, which is taken off the fish word

parts.note: tuna is a fish

explanation.surface: A fish is tailed before being packed in a barrel.
explanation.definitionFit: A tun is a large cask for wine or beer, a kind of barrel.

clue.text: Chinese way is taken by every single Irish leader

parts.note: Tao is the way in Chinese philosophy
used as written
each means every single one

explanation.surface: An Irish premier adopts Taoist ideas, one by one.
explanation.definitionFit: The Taoiseach is the prime minister of the Republic of Ireland, so its head of government.

clue.text: Welshman with English, caught in row, makes slow disappearance

parts.note: Evan is a typically Welsh first name

indicators.note: in places the caught letter inside the row word

parts.note: a scene is a noisy row or fuss
C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: A Welshman and an Englishman get into a fight, then quietly slip away.
explanation.definitionFit: Evanescence is a fading from sight, the gradual vanishing of something.

clue.text: Utter defeat to confirm with ship's officer

parts.note: to check is to verify or confirm
a mate is a deck officer on a merchant ship

explanation.surface: Total defeat is verified by the first officer.
explanation.definitionFit: In chess this ends the game with the king trapped, so figuratively a complete defeat.

clue.text: Engaged in fraud as was Nero while Rome burned?

definitions.meaning: British slang for cheating or running a scam

definitions.text: as was Nero while Rome burned?
definitions.meaning: legend says Nero played a violin as the city burned

explanation.surface: Nero was a crook as well as a musician while Rome was in flames.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is slang for swindling and also literally means playing a violin.

clue.text: US writer's thunderous god over water in France

indicators.note: over in a down clue puts the god above the water

parts.note: Thor is the Norse god of thunder
eau is French for water

explanation.surface: An American author's thundering deity hovers above French water.
explanation.definitionFit: Henry David Thoreau, author of Walden, was a nineteenth-century American author.

clue.text: Small creature takes Echo — newspaper we prefer!

parts.note: Echo is E in the NATO phonetic alphabet
FT is the Financial Times, the setter's own paper

explanation.surface: A small animal picks up the local Echo rather than the paper we like.
explanation.definitionFit: An eft is a newt, a small amphibian creature.

clue.text: Implicate brother in climbing tree

indicators.note: in places the brother word inside the tree word
climbing in a down clue means the tree word reads upwards

parts.note: a lime is a tree

explanation.surface: A sibling is caught up a tree.
explanation.walkthrough: 'climbing' makes the tree read upwards as EMIL before the sibling goes in.
explanation.definitionFit: To embroil someone is to draw them into a conflict, so to involve or implicate them.

clue.text: One clocks second best whisky at church

parts.note: top means best
Whisky is W in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Someone times how fast the finest whisky goes at a church do.
explanation.definitionFit: A stopwatch times races, so it is a device that clocks events.

clue.text: Welcome here for victor with excited eastern audience

indicators.note: excited means agitated, so the letters of with are stirred

parts.note: used as written
a theatre audience is called the house, as in a full one

explanation.surface: An excited audience from the East greets the winner.
explanation.definitionFit: The winning US presidential candidate moves into this Washington residence, so it welcomes the victor.

clue.text: Capital letters written in ink — a bulletin

indicators.note: the letters are written inside the words ink a bulletin

explanation.surface: Capital letters are printed in ink on a news bulletin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Capital letters' looks like upper case; 'Capital' alone defines.
explanation.definitionFit: Kabul is the capital city of Afghanistan.

clue.text: Failed contender more relaxed after relinquishing an Oscar

indicators.note: relinquishing means giving up, so one O is removed

parts.note: looser means more relaxed
Oscar is O in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A defeated rival is calmer after surrendering an Academy Award.
explanation.definitionFit: A loser is one who is beaten, so a contender who failed.

clue.text: US Minuteman bisects two areas

indicators.note: bisects means cuts in two, so the minute and man letters split the pair
two means the area letter appears twice

parts.note: A is the abbreviation for area
the minute part gives M, the abbreviation for minute
the man part gives Eric, a man's name

explanation.surface: A US militiaman divides two territories.
explanation.definitionFit: The US is the short name for the United States, also named after the continent.

clue.text: Some drivers together around golf range

indicators.note: around means the drivers' letters surround the golf letter

parts.note: the AA is the Automobile Association, a British motorists' organisation
Golf is G in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Several golfers with drivers gather round a driving range.
explanation.walkthrough: 'range' is a kitchen stove here, not a golf range.
explanation.definitionFit: An Aga is a heavy British cooking stove, a kind of range.

clue.text: Old woman on island plumps for insects

indicators.note: on in an across clue puts the woman after the island letter

parts.note: ma is a mother, an old woman
plumps for means goes for, so plumps gives goes

explanation.surface: A grandmother on an island chooses the insects.
explanation.definitionFit: Imagoes are the adult forms of insects after metamorphosis.

clue.text: See 21
Oil trader?

parts.note: not a petroleum merchant but someone selling oil paintings

explanation.walkthrough: 'Oil' suggests petroleum; here it means oil paintings.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who buys and sells paintings, including works in oils.
